headline: Volvo Shares Plunge as Carmaker Plans 2,500 Job Cuts Amid China Slowdown
summary: Swedish automaker Volvo plans to cut 2,500 jobs, joining industry peers in reporting a gloomy outlook for the Chinese car market.
why: Volvo is a prominent multinational automotive manufacturer whose performance reflects broader demand trends in Europe and Asia.

impacts.name: Volvo
impacts.why: Job cuts and weak demand signals point to compressed profit margins and lower vehicle sales volumes.

why_moved: Disappointing demand in key international markets and restructuring expenses weigh heavily on investor sentiment.
